task: Add non-interactive (no-TTY) detection to skip interactive SSO re-authentication prompts and fail fast with a clear error message instead of hanging in CI/automation.

component_scope.label: L
component_scope.layers: Utils (shared TTY-detection helper), Service (provider core auth-failure handling)

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: Change sits in the SSO re-authentication failure path (auth-validation.ts); relies on process.stdin.isTTY detection, which can behave inconsistently across CI runners/terminal wrappers; touches authentication flow (red flag)
technical_risk.mitigation: TTY-guard is a well-established Node.js pattern; change is additive (only skips the existing prompt branch, falls back to the pre-existing non-promptForReauth error path); covered by unit tests for isTTY true/false/undefined and for provider setups with/without promptForReauth

key_reasoning.reason: Introduces a new core shared utility (src/utils/interactive.ts, described in its own docstring as 'Single source of truth' for TTY detection) and wires it into the existing provider auth-failure handler (auth-validation.ts) — two components across two tiers (Utils + Service), which triggers the 'touches core shared utilities' red flag bump from M to L.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M to L: touches a core shared utility (src/utils/interactive.ts, a single-source-of-truth TTY-detection helper intended for reuse by other interactive-prompt guards)
Technical Risk bumped from S to M: affects authentication/authorization flow (auth-validation.ts governs the SSO re-authentication prompt/failure path)
